runs.name: Fisker Inc.; formerly NYSE FSR, then OTC FSRN and FSRNQ; the sheet's FSRDQ matches no filing or notice
runs.entry: Price **none exists**: no aggregator quote for FSRDQ, FSRNQ, FSRN or FSR (2026-10-12); the common stock was cancelled under the Chapter 11 plan effective 2024-10-17 with no distribution (FINRA Uniform Practice Advisory #75-24 of 2024-10-18, a regulator's notice quoting the plan, flagged as not a filing; the issuer's own NT 10-Q of 2024-08-15, 0001628280-24-037402, the last SEC filing: "existing common stock will be cancelled and that holders of the common stock will not receive any amounts"). Shares 1,385,486,856 Class A and 132,354,128 ten-vote Class B as of 2024-04-15 (10-K FY2023 cover, 0001720990-24-000045), against 316,589,859 A at 2023-12-31, the rise from conversions of the 2025 Notes; zero since 2024-10-17. Sovereign **5.60%** (UST 30Y, 2026-10-09). SEC CIK 1720990, formerly Spartan Energy Acquisition Corp. (SPAC, reverse merger 2020); NYSE suspension 2024-03-25, Form 25 2024-04-10; US subsidiaries filed Chapter 11 in Delaware on 2024-06-17 and 2024-06-19 (8-K 0001193125-24-167032). Primary document the FY2023 10-K, with the FY2022 10-K, the Q3 2023 10-Q, the 2023 DEF 14A and the 2024 8-Ks and NT filings; cash at 2023-12-31 $325,452 thousand cross-checked to the filed balance sheet and Item 7. `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` both refused the ticker (not in the live SEC list); the analyst ran `tools/run.py` through a CIK wrapper in the research folder. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 and the later 8-Ks, as the overnight brief directs. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up by its own last 10-K ("As a high-growth startup"; "an early-stage company with a limited operating history"; incorporated September 2016, first revenue Q2 2023, 4,847 vehicles delivered in 2023 for revenue $272.9M against cost of goods sold $558.8M, one model built under contract by Magna Steyr, going-concern doubt), in Q1's named OUT list; the owner's ten-year economics not a forecast but on the record, the equity extinguished. The analyst set down the alternative reading, TOO HARD (NATURE) by Q1's fast-change routing for electric vehicles, and chose OUT because the outcome is known. Q2 to Q12 not reached. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the Q3 2023 10-Q and the FY2023 10-K filed late after the chief accounting officer left (the late 10-Q itself an event of default on the 2025 Notes); four material weaknesses causing material audit adjustments; 2024 guidance withdrawn 2024-04-03; PwC declined to stand for re-appointment 2024-05-07; the married CEO and CFO controlled the vote through ten-vote Class B; a press report of an SEC investigation seen in a search-result title, not read, not used. Beneath the stop, COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost FY2019 to FY2023 -7.4, -39.4, -441.3, -663.1, -904.7 ($M), mean **-$411.2M** equity basis, -$404.2M all-equity; negative throughout, so the no-growth case alone; net debt $901.5M at 2023-12-31; value **-$5.35** a share all-equity (-$4.84 equity-only), fair **-$3.26** all-equity (-$2.71 equity-only), against no price; not armed. Balance sheets: 2017 to 2019 the SPAC's trust only; 2020 to 2023 cash $991M to $325M, equity $1,045M to -$98M, accumulated deficit -$2,107M, convertible notes $0 to $1,227M, inventory $406.5M at 2023 against $272.9M revenue. Competitors: the 10-K names Tesla (filer; gross margin 16.6% to 25.6%, operating margin -0.3% to 16.8%, FY2019 to FY2023, from XBRL transcription) and BMW (not an SEC filer, flagged, not compared); Fisker 2023 gross margin -104.8%, operating margin -220.8%, never a gross profit on a car. Contamination declared by the analyst: git status and recent commit subjects naming other companies (EVI, AYI, ARCB) and the memory index; nothing about Fisker seen, nothing used. **Self-audit failure, declared by the analyst:** write-early not kept; the run file was written in one pass and committed once at the close (8d37fc76), not after Step 0 and Q1. Citations: the analyst's check 22 ids, 15 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's adjacency script (`dispatcher_check.py`) 22 ids present, 10 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold. check_framework PASS. Analyst's gaps for the operator: (1) the framework has no rule for a security that no longer exists (equity cancelled by a confirmed plan, a ticker matching no filing); (2) Q1 does not say whether the start-up OUT item or the fast-change routing to TOO HARD (NATURE) governs when both apply; (3) the reporting convention asks for figures against a price that cannot exist; (4) Q7's decline specific covers a negative growth rate but not a series negative throughout (read as the no-growth case alone); (5) `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` take no CIK, so every delisted name needs a hand wrapper. Not obtained: the plan document itself, any 10-Q after Q3 2023, any price. **For the operator:** the order file's ticker FSRDQ matches no filing; the security the sheet means may be another, or an aggregator's symbol for the same extinguished stock.
runs.narr: Q1 OUT: a start-up by its own last 10-K (first revenue 2023, cost of goods twice revenue, one contract-built model, going-concern doubt), and the equity is gone: Chapter 11 in June 2024, the common stock cancelled under the plan on 2024-10-17 with no distribution (FINRA notice; the issuer's own NT 10-Q said so first). Integrity facts recorded: late filings, four material weaknesses, guidance withdrawn, the auditor declining to stand, a married CEO and CFO in control by ten-vote shares. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: fair -$3.26 all-equity (-$2.71 equity-only) against no price (not armed). The analyst asks for a rule on a security that no longer exists and on which of Q1's two routings governs a start-up in a fast-changing field; the sheet's ticker FSRDQ matches no filing (the filings show FSR, FSRN, FSRNQ).
